_doc: Cultivation realms in order. qi_required(stage) = qi_base * qi_growth^stage. base_qi_per_day is the rate for a 1.0x character in a 1.0 density area. breakthrough_chance / failure_qi_loss apply when breaking INTO this realm from the previous realm's final stage. description (C-084): one or two sentences of genre voice about what the realm means to a cultivator, no numbers, under 220 characters; every realm needs one. Balance rule (F-005b, enforced by test_data): the lifespan gained by entering the next realm must be at least 10x Cultivation.expected_realm_years for this realm at a 1.0x cultivator, so a sensible cultivator almost never dies of old age. tribulation (optional): a Heavenly Tribulation summoned when a breakthrough INTO this realm succeeds (Tribulation system): waves lightning waves, the first striking with attack = this realm's combat power (Combat.realm_power at stage 0) * strength, each next one * growth, resisted by defense like a combat blow, each rolled at +-variance; the strongest readied shield talisman absorbs damage first, at tribulation_shield_scale (top level, 0..1) of its combat value, or its own items.json combat.tribulation for purpose-made wards (TRIB-001d); only one ward counts and only it burns. Falling before the final wave fails the breakthrough (failure_qi_loss + a tribulation_failure injury from injuries.json); falling to the final wave kills (the Creation Artifact may respawn the player). npc_strength (optional, QA-010): the strength NPCs face instead (they carry no modelled techniques or gear), tuned so a generated NPC survives about as often as a typical player (tests/sim/simulate_tribulation.gd). failure_bonus / failure_bonus_max (FOUND-003, top level): each failed breakthrough attempt (including a failed tribulation) adds failure_bonus to the next attempt's chance, up to failure_bonus_max in total; a success resets it; need 0 <= failure_bonus <= failure_bonus_max <= 0.5. heart_demon: characters with alignment <= max_alignment face an extra wave just before the final one dealing max_hp * hp_fraction * (how demonic they are, 0..1), ignoring defense.

realms.name: Mortal
realms.description: A body of flesh and bone, bound to the dust of the world. The Dao has not yet noticed you, but the first spark of qi waits to be found.

realms.name: Qi Refining
realms.description: You draw the world's qi into your meridians and learn to hold it. Nine layers of patient labor separate the villager from the true cultivator.

realms.name: Foundation Establishment
realms.description: Your scattered qi settles into a foundation as firm as bedrock. Mortals now call you immortal, and the sects begin to take your name seriously.

realms.name: Core Formation
realms.description: Your qi condenses into a golden core, a seed of the Dao within the dantian. Heaven sends its first tribulation to test whether you deserve it.

realms.name: Nascent Soul
realms.description: A tiny infant of pure spirit is born from your core and can leave the body behind. Elders of great sects bow to few, but they bow to you.

realms.name: Soul Formation
realms.description: Body and soul grow strong enough to bear the weight of heaven and earth. Where you stand, the very rules of the world begin to listen.

realms.name: Void Refinement
realms.description: You step between the cracks of reality and bend the void to your will. Distance, hiding and even the sky feel thin to you.

realms.name: Body Integration
realms.description: Flesh, soul and Dao fuse into one, and your body becomes a vessel of the heavens. Few in the mortal world can even see your shadow.

realms.name: Mahayana
realms.description: You have walked nearly to the end of the road, a Great Vehicle carrying all your understanding. Only the final tribulation stands between you and the heavens.

realms.name: Tribulation Transcendence
realms.description: The last lightning gathers over your head. Survive it and you leave the mortal world behind; fail and all you were is ash on the wind.
